newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Banco Filipino declares 55 pct stock div.
newsitem.headline: Banco Filipino declares 55 pct stock div.

text.p: Banco Filipino Savings and Mortgage Bank said on Thursday its board of directors had approved a 55 percent stock dividend and an increase in the company's authorised capital to five billion pesos from three billion.
In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE), the bank said the dividend declaration and capital hike will be presented to stockholders for approval at their annual meeting on March 31.
The dividend will be payable to all common stockholders on record as of January 21.
The 55 percent stock dividend will be used to fully pay up the subscription requirements needed to increase the capital of the bank.
The capital incease will be composed of 49 million shares of common stock with a par value of 100 pesos per share and one million shares of preferred stock with a par value of 100 pesos a share.
